# GourceTree

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGourceTree` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGourceTree.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGourceTree.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGourceTree.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A tree: clustering / phylogenetic, or a Gource-style radial filesystem

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGourceTree> CreateGourceTree( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h );
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGourceTree(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `GourceLayoutMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Static` | Instant radial tree layout |
| `Animated` | Force-directed with animation during data addition |
| `Hybrid` | Radial initial + force relaxation |

### enum `GourceHighlightMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoneHighlight` | No date-based highlighting (renamed from None to avoid X11 macro collision) |
| `LastAccess` | Recent access = opaque, old = transparent |
| `CreationDate` | Recent creation = opaque, old = transparent |
| `InvertLastAccess` | Old access = opaque (show unused files) |
| `InvertCreationDate` | Old creation = opaque |

### enum `GourceNodeType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `File` |  |
| `Directory` |  |
| `CollapsedDirectory` | Directory beyond depth limit |
